title: Melodic's CobbleMore [Datapack]
description: The Datapack Addon for Melodic's CobbleMore
body:
CobbleMore is a server-side Fabric mod that adds structured campaign progression to Cobblemon servers.

  What it does:

  Players travel to dedicated region dimensions (Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh) using /campaign, defeat gym leaders to earn badges, and challenge the Pokemon League once they've collected all 8. Legendary portal
   events spawn periodically in the overworld, teleporting players to a realm with legendary monument encounters.

  Key features:

  - Campaign dimensions with saved player positions
  - Badge-gated gym progression (can't skip ahead)
  - Pokemon League with Elite Four one-way progression and blackout reset
  - Automated legendary portal events with structure placement
  - Cobblemon dialogue integration for NPCs (League Masters, guides, champion victory)
  - Built-in poll and feedback system for community engagement
  - Full admin toolkit for zone building, tag management, and config hot-reload

  Requires: Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric, Fabric API, Cobblemon 1.7.x
